take: Toronto announced it has placed F Colton Sissons on injured reserve and recalled F Brendan Brisson from Toronto (AHL). Sissons, a third-line forward who plays 13:31 a night and kills penalties, has missed one game so far, and in that game Nick Paul took his spot beside McKenna while Easton Cowan's ice time rose from 16:43 to 19:04 a night. The Maple Leafs (8-10-2) have controlled 46.8% of the expected goals, a measure of chance quality, and Sissons is at 43.59% at five-on-five, so the drop-off is small.
